old: !insertmacro MUI_HEADER_TEXT "Choose file associations" "Optional settings for Litematica Preview"
new: !insertmacro MUI_HEADER_TEXT "选择文件关联" "Litematica Preview 的可选设置"

old: Setup could not show the file-association options. Please run setup again.
new: 安装程序无法显示文件关联选项，请重新运行安装程序。

old: Windows keeps your current default apps. Add Litematica Preview to Open with for selected formats, then choose defaults in Windows Settings.
new: Windows 会保留你当前的默认应用。安装程序会把 Litematica Preview 添加到所选格式的“打开方式”中，之后可在 Windows 设置中选择默认应用。

old: Register Litematica Preview for these file types
new: 为这些文件类型注册 Litematica Preview

old: Open Default Apps Settings after installation
new: 安装后打开“默认应用”设置

old: Select at least one file type, or uncheck registration to continue.
new: 请至少选择一种文件类型，或取消勾选注册后继续。

old: DetailPrint "File registration is off. Removing only associations owned by this installation."
new: DetailPrint "未启用文件注册。仅移除本次安装所拥有的关联。"

old: Litematica Preview was installed, but setup could not start the file-association update. You can change file associations from the app.
new: Litematica Preview 已安装，但安装程序无法启动文件关联更新。你可以稍后在应用内更改文件关联。

old: Litematica Preview was installed, but file associations could not be fully updated. Another installed copy may own them. You can change file associations from the app.
new: Litematica Preview 已安装，但文件关联未能完全更新。可能是另一份已安装副本占用了关联。你可以稍后在应用内更改文件关联。

old: DetailPrint "File-association choices applied. Windows default-app choices were preserved."
new: DetailPrint "文件关联选项已应用。Windows 的默认应用选择保持不变。"

old: DetailPrint "Opening Windows Default Apps Settings as requested."
new: DetailPrint "正在按要求打开 Windows“默认应用”设置。"

old: Setup could not open Windows Settings. Open Settings > Apps > Default apps to choose Litematica Preview.
new: 安装程序无法打开 Windows 设置。请打开“设置 > 应用 > 默认应用”来选择 Litematica Preview。

old: Windows Settings could not be opened. Open Settings > Apps > Default apps to choose Litematica Preview.
new: 无法打开 Windows 设置。请打开“设置 > 应用 > 默认应用”来选择 Litematica Preview。

old: Could not start file-association cleanup. The app has not been removed.
new: 无法启动文件关联清理，应用尚未被卸载。

new: 无法清理文件关联，应用尚未被卸载。
